searched: Searched (all retrieval direct, sequential, 29 October 2026): the arXiv API for "StepFun" (12 papers listed) and the abstract pages and v1 PDFs of Step-Video-T2V (2502.10248), Step-Audio (2502.11946), Step1X-Edit (2504.17761), Step-Audio 2 (2507.16632), Step-3 (2507.19427) and NextStep-1 (2508.10711); the Hugging Face model listing of stepfun-ai (55 repositories) and the commit lists and pinned README/LICENSE files of step3, Step-3.5-Flash, Step-5-Preview, stepvideo-t2v and Step-Audio-Chat; stepfun.com (https://www.stepfun.com/ and https://www.stepfun.com/company both return HTTP 200 with a 2,262-byte JavaScript shell and no text; the newsroom posts and footer were read in the site's content-hashed build file https://www.stepfun.com/assets/index-4zBpLKmx.js, HTTP 200) and one static blog page (static.stepfun.com/blog/step-3.5-flash/, retrieved, not cited); the 36Kr republication of QbitAI of 27 January 2026 already in the dataset. For 01.AI: the abstract pages and v1 PDFs of the Yi report (2403.04652) and the Yi-Lightning report (2412.01253); the Hugging Face listing of 01-ai (28 repositories), commit lists of Yi-34B, Yi-1.5-34B and Yi-Coder-9B, and a blob-less clone of the Yi-34B Hugging Face repository and of github.com/01-ai/Yi (scratch directory) for LICENSE and README history; lingyiwanwu.com (home, about, newsroom; https://www.lingyiwanwu.com/yi-license, named in the v2.1 licence as the home of the commercial licence agreement, now serves the homepage, HTTP 200, so that agreement was not retrieved), www.01.ai (English home) and two WeChat posts linked from the 01.AI newsroom. A few Hugging Face API metadata lookups (model info, file trees at a commit) were made with plain curl for discovery only and are not cited. No retrieval was refused with an HTTP error; the failures are content failures: the stepfun.com JavaScript shell (above), the removed yi-license page (above), and the stepvideo-t2v README at commit fe3a312810e4 (2025-02-14), which holds only a licence tag. Web.archive.org was not tried (refuses connections here); the cross-family checker may wish to open archive copies of https://www.stepfun.com/, https://www.stepfun.com/company and https://www.lingyiwanwu.com/yi-license. Left out: (1) a StepFun founding statement in its own words exists only in the meta description of the stepfun.com HTML shell ("阶跃星辰于2023年4月成立"), which the tool's text layer excludes, so it was not drafted; the existing reporting-based record lg-cn-stepfun-founded-2023 stands. (2) StepFun's own newsroom post dated 26 January 2026 ("官宣！印奇出任阶跃星辰董事长", in the build file) states that Yin Qi took up the post of chairman and names CEO Jiang Daxin, chief scientist Zhang Xiangyu and CTO Zhu Yibo as the core management team: it is a primary expression of the four existing reporting-based role records, which were not redrafted; the coordinator may add it as evidence to them. The same post says Yin Qi is also chairman of 千里科技 (not drafted: no such entity in the dataset, and a statement by StepFun rather than by that company). (3) No StepFun or 01.AI funding announcement or filing was located; the StepFun B+ round rests on reporting and names no investors; earlier StepFun rounds and all 01.AI rounds were not drafted. (4) No standalone safety framework or commitment text published by StepFun or 01.AI was located on the pages searched; 01.AI's RAISE is recorded only as described in its two reports. (5) Left out for budget: StepFun's Step-Video-TI2V, GOT-OCR2.0, Step1X-3D, Step-Audio-EditX/R1, Step3-VL-10B, Step-3.7-Flash, StepAudio 3 and Step Edge releases and its partnership posts (Tencent Cloud, Kingdee, Qianli, 上海期智研究院); 01.AI's Yi-VL, Yi-9B and Yi-Large (API only, no document), the Yi licence v2.0 of 4 November 2023 (retrieved, not drafted), and the remaining timeline items of 01.AI's about page. (6) Authorship of existing StepFun people is recorded on the Step-3 report only; the same names appear on the Step-Video-T2V, Step-Audio, Step1X-Edit and NextStep-1 author lists. No existing dataset person appears in the Yi or Yi-Lightning author lists (Kai-Fu Lee is not listed). The Step1X-Edit PDF prints corresponding-author e-mail addresses; nothing from that passage is quoted.
